_note: Guided start and Mr. Algo hints. Each step: say = lines, spot = station id to spotlight, wait = event that ends the step (stationOpen:<id>, sample:requested, sample:taken, studio:open). Hints are checked top to bottom; the first whose conditions all hold is shown when you ask Mr. Algo.

say: Hi. I am Mr. Algo. I used to be a smart speaker.
I know exactly how the algorithm works. Trust me.
You have 1,500 pesos and a phone. Let's sell something.
Go to the desk PC. It opens on the Affiliate site.
Pick a product and press Request sample.
Good. Samples take a few hours to arrive. Time keeps moving.
Check the feeds on the PC or phone while you wait. Watch what sellers post.
The sample is at the door. Take it in.
Now film it at the filming corner. Plan your shots, shoot them, edit, and post.

hints.text: Open the desk PC. Go to the Affiliate site. Request a sample.
Your sample is on its way. Check the feeds while you wait, or nap to pass time.
Something is waiting at the door. Take it in.
Film your product at the filming corner. Four short clips, then edit and post.
Your post is live. Open the PC, then a site, then My posts to watch it.
Open the results of your last post. I have three things to tell you.
You are tired. Nap or sleep at the bed.
Read the feeds. Look for products many people are asking about.
